content.text: Who could I talk to about the day Emmons left? Was there anyone you know that was there?
That’s my project tonight. I hear from one person they think he might have worked less than 2 weeks, another that they didn’t think he was actually walked out, etc.

Not sure who would talk on the record about it. Plenty were there, but a lot of the office was at spring training. Karen fired him over the phone at Duane’s request. Pett was in the room. Myself, Jeff Sanders and Kelsey Decker were told by Pett but weren’t present.
He definitely didn’t work less than 2 weeks. That’s proven
And you said you thought it was the day of the clickondetroit story
And that could be the date, I’m just trying to double check on it given the info
Yea I guess I don’t know that for sure. I remember we were told by Pett and then we looked online and found that story. He definitely wasn’t fired BEFORE the story.
